title: Sources: EU leaders are divided on curbing Big Tech as they weigh cloud tender rules and giving EU companies preferential access to mobile satellite spectrum (Foo Yun Chee/Reuters)
summary: Foo Yun Chee / Reuters: Sources: EU leaders are divided on curbing Big Tech as they weigh cloud tender rules and giving EU companies preferential access to mobile satellite spectrum — European leaders are divided on how far to go in curbing Big Tech as they weigh momentous decisions over giving EU firms preferential access …
